basic_details.job_title: RGCB Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: Strong proficiency in Python and digital signal processing libraries (NumPy, SciPy). Hands-on experience with single-board computers (Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson, or similar). Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow).

selection_process: The selection process involves online application submission
shortlisting of eligible candidates based on criteria
how_to_apply: Ensure you meet the essential qualifications for the Project Technical Support - III position.
Submit your application online through the designated submission process.
Ensure the completed application is submitted on or before 14 October 2026.
Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel.
important_instructions: Applications which are not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Only those fulfilling the above criteria need apply. Applicants will be short listed for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview. If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position. Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise). As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co-terminus with the end of the project. Duration of the project is initially for a period of one year or till termination of the project whichever is earlier and extendable based on the performance evaluation.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this post?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are notified under RGCB Advt No. 12/2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support - III post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a BCA, B.Tech Computer Science, Electrical and Communication Engineering or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 35 years of age on 14th October 2026, with age relaxation applicable as per Govt. of India norms.
